title: Tic-Tac-Toe, Three Ways
subtitle: The same game in React (4x4 with AI), React (time-travel history) and Unity — swipe through the three versions.

variants.title: 4x4 with AI · React
variants.subtitle: Interactive 4x4 Tic-Tac-Toe with AI opponent and responsive design
variants.challenge: Implement efficient win detection on a 4x4 board with multiple win conditions (rows, columns, diagonals), and integrate a computer AI that suggests valid moves without requiring complex minimax algorithms for this extended board size.
variants.architecture: Component-based React architecture with functional components and hooks for state management; game logic separated into helper functions with constant definitions for player states and game conditions, implementing an event-driven pattern for user interactions.

variants.title: Time Travel · React
variants.subtitle: Interactive React-based Tic-Tac-Toe with move history and time travel
variants.challenge: Implement game logic that detects winners across multiple board states while maintaining move history for time travel functionality. The challenge involves managing complex state transitions and efficiently tracking game progression without mutations.
variants.architecture: Component-driven React architecture with state lifting to Game component. Event-driven board interaction pattern with pure function utilities (calculateWinner) for deterministic game logic. Immutable state updates using array slicing for history management.

variants.title: Animated · Unity
variants.subtitle: Unity Tic-Tac-Toe with responsive UI and win animations
variants.challenge: Implemented responsive turn-based logic, win detection, and animated UI feedback in Unity while keeping game state clean and restartable.
variants.architecture: Event-driven MonoBehaviour flow with UI button listeners and coroutine-based animation.
